## What it is

A short rib, one clip, and a slot gauge, joined by a link. The digit is 1, same as the start tower.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, like a tower. The gauge is two cheeks and a back wall. The gap is 6.2 mm wide and the cheeks are 3.4 mm tall, open on top, so there is no ceiling.
- Snap the link off and set the tab into the gauge. The 0.2 mm allowance is a design choice. If it binds, raise `joint_clear` before printing the towers.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't treat a coupon that fits as proof the cap and the coil are stiff. It only checks the slot and one clip.
